newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela caps oil municipal taxes at four percent.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela caps oil municipal taxes at four percent.

text.p: Venezuela's state-owned oil company Petroleos de Venezuela has set a four percent ceiling on municipal taxes in the third round of operating licences due to be awarded in June, a potential bidder who saw the final copy of the contract said on Friday.

Municipal taxes are an unpopular levy for foreign oil companies working in Venezuela because they are set at the discretion of local governments, anywhere from less than one to eight percent, and are charged on gross revenues.
"In the final version of the new contract, PDVSA has agreed to compensate the contractor for municipal taxes above four percent," the bidder said.
He added that one problem of PDVSA's cap was that it might encourage municipalities to charge the full four percent if they weren't doing so already.
